_provenance: Ind AS 2017 rules contradicted by the MCA-accepted Dixon instance (data/Instance_Dixon_Global_Private_2025-26_001.xml, Webtel v32.7, FY 2025-26). Each entry: the rule text, the Dixon facts and why MCA's acceptance justifies it. The failures it names are reported as warnings with this evidence, never dropped. 'concepts' / 'scopes' narrow an entry to those elements / periods (CY, PY, PYO = previous-year opening). Added 2026-11-11 (Phase 9, ADR-0011).

rules.instanceFact: OtherIntangibleAssets = 0 for 2026-03-31 and 2025-03-31; the note [400900] is not filed and the Yes/No element is absent
rules.evidence: MCA-accepted Dixon instance (FY 2025-26) omits this element while Other intangible assets are nil and the [400900] note is not filed: MCA requires it only with the note.

rules.ruleText: Mandatory line items of DisclosureOfShareholdingMoreThanFivePerCentInCompanyTable: TypeOfShare, NameOfShareholder, CountryOfIncorporationOrResidenceOfShareholder, NumberOfSharesHeldInCompany, PercentageOfShareholding
rules.instanceFact: NumberOfSharesHeldInCompany 1,000,000 on [EquityShares1Member] alone (the class total) for both years, next to the shareholder row [EquityShares1Member, Shareholder1Member] that carries NameOfShareholder
rules.evidence: MCA-accepted Dixon instance (FY 2025-26) reports the class-total row of the 5% shareholders table without a shareholder name or country: the names are required on shareholder rows, not on the class total.

rules.ruleText: [612200] There are 3 tables in this ELR. One of the table should be entered if "yes" is selected in "Whether company has entered into any lease agreement"
rules.instanceFact: WhetherCompanyHasEnteredIntoAnyLeaseAgreement = true for FY 2024-25 (false for FY 2025-26); none of the three lease tables has previous-year data
rules.evidence: MCA-accepted Dixon instance (FY 2025-26) answers Yes for the previous year without previous-year lease tables: the tables are required for the current year only (comparatives of dimensional tables are not required, generic rule 5).

rules.ruleText: DescriptionOfPresentationCurrency: This is a mandatory field
rules.evidence: MCA-accepted Dixon instance (FY 2025-26) reports the presentation currency for the current year only; general information is not reported for the previous year (generic rule 11).

rules.ruleText: [700300] DescriptionOfPresentationCurrency: This is a mandatory field
rules.evidence: MCA-accepted Dixon instance (FY 2025-26) reports the presentation currency for the current year only; general information is not reported for the previous year (generic rule 11).

rules.ruleText: Generic rule 1: … It should be mandatory to enter atleast one child element if parent element is entered and vice-a-versa
rules.instanceFact: EquityShareCapital 10,000,000 at 2024-03-31 (opening of the previous year, statement of changes in equity) without EquityAttributableToOwnersOfParent at that date
rules.evidence: MCA-accepted Dixon instance (FY 2025-26) reports the previous-year opening equity share capital of the statement of changes in equity without its balance-sheet total for that date: the balance sheet has no column for it.
